jobs.description:
Are you an Automation Engineer looking to contribute to major industrial projects and help shape the future of manufacturing on an international scale?

Based in Lembeke, you will join the Group Engineering team of a leading international food manufacturer recognised for its strong growth, technological expertise and significant investment in its global production capabilities.

 

Following major investments in new production facilities and the continued expansion of its industrial footprint, the Group is pursuing the development of its manufacturing network worldwide.

As Automation Project Engineer, you will contribute to this ambition by delivering automation projects across both new production facilities and existing plants. You will help deploy advanced technologies, optimise production performance and develop consistent automation standards across the Group. 

 

Your responsibilities

•  Lead automation projects from concept to commissioning
• Lead and/or execute automation engineering projects in collaboration with local engineering, maintenance and production teams.
• Manage the full project lifecycle, from requirements definition and concept development to budgeting, tendering, detailed engineering, implementation, commissioning and aftercare.
• Contribute to major CAPEX investments, including new production facilities and greenfield projects, as well as the modernisation and revamping of existing production lines.
• Coordinate external engineering partners, suppliers and technical specialists when required.
• Ensure projects meet agreed technical specifications, quality standards, budgets and timelines.
• Identify potential technical challenges and work with relevant stakeholders to develop practical, reliable solutions.
•  Support an international manufacturing network
• Understand site-specific requirements and translate them into robust, efficient automation solutions.
• Support the integration and deployment of automation systems across different production environments.
• Coordinate with local teams to ensure that project solutions meet operational needs and can be effectively implemented on site.
• Share technical expertise, lessons learned and best practices across the Group's international network.
• Travel internationally when required to support project execution, installation and commissioning.
•  Develop automation expertise and standards at Group level
• Act as a technical sparring partner for plant teams, suppliers and external specialists.
• Provide technical guidance on complex automation topics and equipment integration.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of Group-wide automation standards, guidelines and working procedures.
• Promote structured project management practices and the consistent application of technical standards.
• Help ensure that automation solutions are reliable, maintainable and aligned with the Group's long-term industrial development.
•  Explore new technologies and drive continuous improvement
• Stay up to date with developments in industrial automation, digitalisation, Industry 4.0, food manufacturing technology and packaging equipment.
• Identify opportunities to improve production performance, equipment reliability, flexibility and maintainability.
• Evaluate new technologies and assess their practical application within the Group's manufacturing environment.
• Contribute to the selection and implementation of innovative automation solutions.

Your profile

You hold a Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline, combined with a minumum of 3 years of experience in industrial automation.

You combine strong technical knowledge with a structured, hands-on approach to project delivery and the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders across an international organisation.

Your experience and skills include:

• Experience in industrial manufacturing, ideally in a production environment.
• Strong knowledge of PLCs and industrial automation systems, with hands-on experience with Rockwell and/or Siemens PLCs.
• Familiarity with HMI, SCADA and industrial control systems.
• Experience managing or contributing to CAPEX projects, equipment integration, new installations or production-line revamping.
• A good understanding of the interfaces between automation, electrical, mechanical and production systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical challenges into clear, practical solutions.
• An interest in new technologies, digitalisation and continuous improvement.
• A structured and hands-on approach, combined with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of projects.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions, sites and cultures.
• Professional fluency in Dutch & English; additional languages are an asset.
• Willingness to travel internationally in line with project requirements

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

Job description 

Our client in the Kortrijk/Menen region is looking for CE drivers for transporting sea containers. Usually for picking up and dropping off, but sometimes also just unloading at the quay. Nice working days of approximately 12 hours and home every day.

Loading and unloading locations at terminals in the ports of Ghent/Antwerp and at the client's warehouses and companies.

 Requirements 

You are motivated to work in the ports. You have a valid CE driving license with C95.

You have a good knowledge of Dutch, English, or French.

You live in the Kortrijk/Westhoek region.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 

Looking for freedom and your own dedicated truck (after your onboarding period)? This is your route:

    
• 
        
What: National transport (tipper and curtain-sider) of steel and miscellaneous materials.

    
    
• 
        
When: Early mornings (start between 4 AM and 6 AM) for a full 10-12 hour day.

    
    
• 
        
How: Independently, punctually, and in close contact with dispatch.

    

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid CE license + Code 95.

    
    
• 
        
Speaks Dutch, French, or English.

    
    
• 
        
An early bird who loves working independently and accurately.

    
    
• 
        
An honest team player who cares for the equipment and the customer.

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Harelbeke site, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician in night shift As a maintenance technician, you are passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these findings accurately, allowing us to act proactively and minimise unplanned downtime. 
 
• You perform scheduled maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
 
• You work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
 
• You provide external employees with the necessary support and follow-up to make their contribution effective and efficient. You also supervise technical trainees and new employees to help them grow in their roles. 
 
• You keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo). 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in night shift

Job description 
 What will you do? 
    
• 
        
Play the early bird: The road is yours while the rest of the world is still hitting snooze.

    
    
• 
        
Embrace variety: Shuttle between regional clients carrying agricultural products, sand, gravel, or waste (no ADR stress!).

    
    
• 
        
Be versatile: Switch smoothly between a tipper and a curtain-sider like it's nothing.

    
    
• 
        
Build some muscle: A physical challenge doesn't scare you off.

    

 Requirements 
 Who are you? 
    
• 
        
You hold a CE License + Code 95 (crucial, otherwise things get awkward with the police).

    
    
• 
        
You speak Dutch, French, or English (as long as we can understand each other by the coffee machine).

    
    
• 
        
You are flexible, precise, and treat your truck as if it were your own.

    
    
• 
        
Want extra hours? Great! More hours = more cash.

Lead the technical evolution of a modern cloud platform, combining .NET development, software architecture, AI-assisted engineering, and technical leadership.

Our partner is a technology-driven organization investing heavily in cloud-native development, AI-assisted software engineering, and modern platform architecture.

As part of a growing engineering team, they are looking for a Senior Developer / Tech Lead who can combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities.

This role goes far beyond pure development. You'll influence architectural decisions, mentor developers, drive engineering excellence, and help shape the future of an AI-native software delivery environment where AI agents actively support coding, testing, and refactoring activities.
Senior Tech Lead | The Role
• Design, build, and enhance scalable applications using .NET, C# and Microsoft Azure.
• Transform business requirements into robust technical solutions, architectures, and implementation plans.
• Establish and promote high engineering standards through code reviews, mentoring, and technical coaching.
• Work alongside AI-powered development tools to accelerate delivery while ensuring the quality, security, and maintainability of the resulting software.
• Drive architectural decisions and contribute to the evolution of cloud-native and event-driven systems.
• Identify opportunities to improve development practices, platform performance, delivery processes, and technical solutions.
Senior Tech Lead | The Profile
• You bring extensive experience in .NET / C# software development, ideally within complex enterprise environments.
• You have strong expertise with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based architectures.
• You are comfortable working with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• You have experience with Angular or modern front-end development frameworks.
• You regularly leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions and understand both their strengths and limitations.
• You have a proven ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, challenge architectural decisions, and drive software quality across a development team.
• Complete proficiency in Dutch, English and French
 

Nice to Have

• Experience with Event-Driven Architecture, messaging systems, and asynchronous integrations.
• Exposure to GraphQL, PostgreSQL, or document-oriented data management.
• Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and scalable software design practices.
• Experience with event sourcing patterns and distributed applications.
• Familiarity with modern search and analytics technologies.
• Microsoft Azure or DevOps certifications are considered a plus.

Support the CEO and executive leadership team by ensuring the smooth coordination of administrative, organizational, marketing, and operational activities.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established organization operating in a dynamic and professional environment, offering a central role with direct exposure to senior management and strategic decision-making.

Description

• Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, and appointments.
• Coordinate recurring management, board, and shareholder meetings.
• Handle incoming and outgoing communications, including urgent matters.
• Maintain and update key contacts and administrative records.
• Prepare meeting materials and coordinate attendees.
• Support telephone reception and general administrative tasks.
• Assist with marketing activities, including client events, website management, and LinkedIn communications.
• Coordinate facility-related projects and external service providers across offices.

• Experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, or Office Manager.
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good level of English.
• Proactive, autonomous, and highly organized.
• Professional, discreet, and trustworthy.
• Strong communication skills and comfortable working with senior stakeholders.

Job description 

    
• No experience in car transport required (CE licence experience is essential)
    
• Working week: Mon–Fri (full-time; longer hours possible but not compulsory)
    
• You may take the lorry home – can leave from your place of residence
    
• Language: German or English (minimum)
    
• Candidates may live in Belgium (German payroll)

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

Job description 

You will be responsible for delivering meat to companies, distribution centers, or supermarkets with a refrigerated trailer.

Possibility of driving shuttles between the customer and distribution centers.

Loading at the processor and 2 to 3 stops per day. Unloading at the dock or using the loading bridge and electric pallet truck.

Working from Monday to Friday.

Ready to hit the road? Apply today and join our team of drivers!

 

 Requirements 

    
• CE driver's license with a valid C95.
    
• You have initial experience in refrigerated transport.
    
• You are Dutch or speak English well.
    
• Shifts from 10 to 13 hours per day.
    
• Good, open communication with planning/management.
